[[File:Force_Disperser.jpg|thumb|250px|Darth Sidious' Force Disperser]]
'''Force Dispersers''' were [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith]] devices that could help a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] conceal his or her presence in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], who served as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] under his public persona of Palpatine, notably kept one in his [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends#Private Office (Private Use)|private office]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Star Wars: Beware the Sith">''[[Star Wars: Beware the Sith]]''</ref>
